## 11.2 Resolution inside the existing Homecoming MEET
## 11.2 Resolution inside the existing Homecoming MEET
target_blocks.text: | **Give it to a Hearth-mate**   | The object becomes that Hearth-mate's personal Keepsake and occupies their Keepsake relationship under ordinary rules.          | The return and succession are entered into the deceased Citizen's closed Tale, the recipient's Tale, and the Item Tale. |

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## 11.2 Resolution inside the existing Homecoming MEET
target_blocks.text: | **Retire it to civic display** | The object becomes a memorial display in the Gathering Place; where species presentation uses a Story Circle, it appears there. | The display records the Citizen, the loss, and the Homecoming that brought the object back.                             |

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## 11.2 Resolution inside the existing Homecoming MEET
target_blocks.text:
<!--@11.2¶3-->
• The Homecoming choice is meaning-making, not inventory recovery. The Keepsake never automatically seeks the mechanically strongest successor.

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## 11.2 Resolution inside the existing Homecoming MEET
target_blocks.text:
<!--@11.2¶4-->
• A transfer is offered to an eligible Hearth-mate, not to an unrestricted Colony-wide list of Citizens.

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## 11.2 Resolution inside the existing Homecoming MEET
target_blocks.text:
<!--@11.2¶5-->
• Retired display removes the object from personal equipment while preserving it as a visible civic memory.
